_capture_meta.purpose: School A — Academic Year creation. AY entity holds its own calendarType (separate from school.academicCalendarType + tenant.defaultCalendarSystem).

_findings: ✅ BS conversion is automatic: server computed startDateBS=2083/01/02 and endDateBS=2083/12/30 from the AD inputs. This is gregorianToBs from @aibrains/shared-types working server-side.

⚠️ calendarType='semester' is a US idiom. Nepal academic calendars are usually annual (one big year, optionally split into terms). The school root carries academicCalendarType='annual', but the AY child carries calendarType='semester' — yet another sub-resource keyspace where the same concept disagrees with itself.

⚠️ AY status lifecycle is 'planning' → 'active' (separate PUT /status). The school itself is also 'setup' → 'active' (separate PATCH /status). Two independent state machines, both gating Academics module access.
